identification: Five hand-painted chalkware wall heads (pirate with eye patch, turbaned figures, Arab in keffiyeh) on black felt in a gilt frame. Photo shows the classic Bossons (Congleton, England, 1946-1996) character-head style; 'Boston' in title is almost certainly a misspelling. Backs not shown, so no Bossons stamp confirmed. Frame is a plain gilt picture frame, adds little.
